scripts.build:web:
expo export -p web && node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const file = "dist/index.html"; let html = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"); if (!html.includes("fonts.googleapis.com")) { const fonts = "<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  "; html = html.replace("<link rel="icon"", fonts + "<link rel="icon""); fs.writeFileSync(file, html); console.log("Injected Google Fonts"); }'
scripts.scraper: cd scraper && source venv/bin/activate && python scraper.py
